title: Adding avatars to the game to give it more 'personality'
author: Technical_Ideal9
selftext:
Decided to give each ship a 'pilot' to give the game a bit more personality, was easier than expected.

Turns out the Google Omni flash 360p works perfect, as the size is well under 1 mb. Basically to get the endless loop you need to start with the same first and last frame (image to video) and then either an 'idle' animation prompt or a simple 4 second speech segment. 

After that I simply asked Claude to place certain 'triggers' in the admin panel where I can upload the videos that fire depending on the trigger. 

  
I think it turned out decent. Game here: [https://cosmoarena.co](https://cosmoarena.co)
